system: You are a helpful, concise assistant.

scorers.exact: trim, strip surrounding quotes/backticks/asterisks and trailing . ! ?, lowercase; must equal expect (lowercased)
scorers.exact_case: trim only; must equal expect exactly (case-sensitive)
scorers.number: drop thousands commas, take the LAST number in the output; must equal expect
scorers.word_count: number of whitespace-separated words must equal expect
scorers.csv_set: split on commas, trim, strip trailing ., lowercase; the set must equal expect
scorers.json: strip ``` fences, parse the whole remainder as JSON; every key in expect must be present with an equal value (strings compared case-insensitively)
scorers.timed: not scored; only timings and length are recorded
